dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, I'd quite like to record my discoveries here in my encyclopedia.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: When I was chatting with Tubby earlier, she even gave me a feather. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, if Tubby's okay with it...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry, I already asked! I always make sure to get permission, as long as the subject is someone I can talk to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what if they're not?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: W—Well, in that case... I guess I'd figure it out on the fly?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, the times I tracked that Rishboland Tiger and those water birds in Sumeru were really dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Rishboland Tigers are highly territorial, so I set up camp some distance away from its den to allow for easier observation.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Apparently, the fur on a Rishboland Tiger's temples allows it to measure distances. I wanted to verify this claim... but unfortunately, I got a little too close.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Racing a Rishboland Tiger through the jungle really isn't something I'd recommend, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If it weren't for a passing Forest Ranger coming to my rescue, I might not have made it out alive...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But thanks to that experience, I also learned about a special rainforest fungus whose spores are the bane of the Rishboland Tiger.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: And with that, another page was added to my encyclopedia. So, I guess you could call it a blessing in disguise!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess... but how did chasing after water birds land you in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Well, it wasn't the water birds themselves that were dangerous, but rather the environment they live in.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Lumi and I were in a small boat watching them build nests in their wetland habitat. They would pick up floating twigs and branches to use as nesting material.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But clearly, besides us, there were other animals that had figured out their nesting habits.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Those floating branches were actually traps. These other animals would wait for the water birds to wade out and pick them up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so there were Spinocrocodiles... I shouldn't be surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Exactly! A huge Spinocrocodile suddenly leaped out of the water, and the waves it created almost capsized our boat.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That noise alerted other Spinocrocodiles nearby, and somehow, they ended up deciding that Lumi and I would make even better prey...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Luckily, they're not as agile on land as they are in water. Once we made it to dry ground, they stopped chasing us.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: So if you're ever planning on going birdwatching in the wetlands, watch out for the dangers in the water too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's certainly a valuable lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Right? I don't want to toot my own horn, but my lectures for fresh-faced adventurers are really quite popular.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you considered turning them into picture books?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Those little educational picture books for kids? I've never considered that before...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But it's not a bad idea! The children in the Conch Gang can't get enough of my stories. Maybe I have a special talent? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Besides, if I can get published, the royalties would go a long way...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Yeah! There's no time to lose... Let's get started right away!
